video_title: Wemby's MVP Campaign has BEGUN, Udoka RIPS Rockets + Trade Market Buzz | The Hoop Collective

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's historic 50-point, 5-block performance against the Pelicans
quotes.excerpt: Victor Wembanyama... did all of this in 32 minutes. 29 shots. That's aggressive.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: You know who needed a friend this weekend? The New Orleans Pelicans. Victor Wembanyama. The box score that he had, this is a pretty darn unique box score. The first number is probably the most unique part about this box score, MacMahon. He did all of this in 32 minutes. 29 shots. That's aggressive. However, he made 20 of them. Five of them were threes, which is the most threes he's made in a game this season. 18 rebounds, four steals, five blocks, stocks, as they say.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's defensive impact and potential as a triple-double threat with blocks
quotes.excerpt: If stocks became an accepted metric, that's what he could sniff around averaging a triple-double in.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Nine blocks. If stocks became an accepted metric, that's what he could sniff around averaging a triple-double in, would be stocks.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's finger injury and the physical toll of his dunking
quotes.excerpt: He's got this hellacious blister on his finger and he says it's absolute agony whenever he dunks.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: He's got this hellacious blister on his finger and he says it's absolute agony whenever he dunks. So the dunking is painful. He keeps ripping it open and everything. So you know I'm always calling for him to dunk, dunk, dunk. And I think part of the reason he's having an even better start to this season than last year is because he's dunking like crazy. He is trying to moderate his dunks a little bit because he's injuring himself.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's refusal to engage in stat-padding
quotes.excerpt: Unlike many of my peers, I'm not very good at stat-padding.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: He said, I think this is pretty much a direct quote, unlike many of my peers, I'm not very good at stat-padding.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Oh. Okay. So that's a fastball.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's early MVP campaign and his impact on the league
quotes.excerpt: What that tells me is Wembanyama is already thinking very much about the MVP.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: What that tells me is Wembanyama is already thinking very much about the MVP.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Well, now that I agree with. Because as you know, he declared himself, I mean, and he was not out of line, I mean, he lobbied hard for it last year.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Ime Udoka's harsh public criticism of the Rockets' defensive effort
quotes.excerpt: They had four 30-point quarters... You're not going to win anything, and that just shows a lack of effort.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: He said, they had four 30-point quarters. You're not going to win anything, and that just shows a lack of effort, attention to detail or fight on that end. And so, it doesn't really matter what we did offensively. Play that poorly defensively, you're not going to win any games. There's no effort or any attention to detail on the defensive end at all.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Ime, you know, they lost 30 times last year. He probably fired 30 bullets.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson's response to Ime Udoka's criticism
quotes.excerpt: Sometimes you gotta block the coach out sometimes and just do you. You gotta be confident.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Amen Thompson said, quote, sometimes you gotta block the coach out sometimes and just do you. You gotta be confident. We gotta be confident.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Yeah, the one thing I would say is, I think, sometimes, like for example, last year with, when KD was missing time in the playoffs and they asked Amen about it, and he basically, he said something along the lines of like, I don't know, I haven't seen him. And what he was trying to say was nothing, and it turned into something. And so I think, I think what he's trying to do is say nothing, and so I think reading something into Amen Thompson's comments is potentially dangerous.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Clippers' trade asset situation and potential for mid-season moves
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers are a team that is going to play into top teams' plans by February.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: What's fascinating about the Clippers, MacMahon, and one of the things that I've noticed since opening night is there's a lot of scouts coming to these games. And they're not advanced scouts, tracking to see what Ty Lue is running, although, you know, Ty Lue is doing his job. They're there to see who's available.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I mean, they're they've got depleted of draft assets. They did get a couple of firsts in the Kawhi deal. But they're depleted of draft assets. I don't think you're getting firsts for any of these guys unless you're taking back long-term bad money as part of the deal.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Bucks as potential sellers with expiring contracts like Tyler Herro
quotes.excerpt: The Bucks have several significant expiring contracts: Kuzma, LeVert, Tyler Hero. Tyler Hero to me is a really interesting one.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: The Bucks have several significant expiring contracts: Kuzma, LeVert, Tyler Hero. Tyler Hero to me is a really interesting one. I think there's probably going to be a pretty significant difference between what Tyler Hero wants in free agency and where the majority of the league sees him. Honestly, I think the majority of the league sees Tyler Hero ideally as a bench bucket-getter, and I don't think that he would like to hear that.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Hero makes 33 million, Kyle Kuzma makes 20 million. Caris LeVert, he's not playing that much, but, you know, he's an expiring that could be used in something. He makes 15 million. Jaime Jaquez, I think that's probably a guy they want to keep, but they didn't extend him. He makes 6 million and is a, you know, technically expiring contract. He would be restricted.
